learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the basics of elastic material behavior and the basic types of loading.
They acquire skills to analyze, calculate, and evaluate the stress on components.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Strength of Materials, tensile and compressive stress, bearing pressure, elongation, Hooke's Law, cutting principle
Fundamentals of Strength of Materials: Area integrals and centroid calculation
Bending: Area moment of inertia, Huygens-Steiner theorem, deflection curve
General state of stress and deformation: Shear stress, stress tensor, Mohr's stress circle, Poisson's ratio, shear
Torsion: polar moment of inertia, closed thin-walled hollow sections
Buckling: critical buckling load, types of bearing
Combined stress: superposition principle, strength hypotheses
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module examination. The assessment method is either a written exam or an oral exam.
bibliography: Kisse, R., Technische Mechanik - Festigkeitslehre, Vorlesungsskript
